claim: ICE is a multiple-agent regimen, not an alias for ifosfamide alone.
Zr89-pembrolizumab is a radiolabeled imaging agent distinct from unlabeled pembrolizumab.
Etoposide phosphate is a covalent prodrug converted by dephosphorylation.
DN101 is a new calcitriol formulation with different systemic exposure.
Tasadenoturev is the oncolytic adenovirus Ad5-DNX2401, not a CCL21-transduced dendritic cell vaccine.
